package quicktype

import io.circe.syntax._
import io.circe._
import cats.syntax.functor._

// If a union has a null in, then we'll need this too... 
type NullValue = None.type

type Count = Long
type Names = List[String]
given (using ev : String): Encoder[Seq[String]] = Encoder.encodeSeq[String]
type Registry = Map[String, Item]

given (using ev : Item): Encoder[Map[String, Item]] = Encoder.encodeMap[String, Item]
type Scores = Map[String, Double]

given (using ev : Double): Encoder[Map[String, Double]] = Encoder.encodeMap[String, Double]

/**
 * The top level.
 */
case class TopLevel (
    val weirdName : String,
    val empty : Boolean,
    val `a b` : String,
    val topLevelAB : Option[String] = None,
    val anything : Option[Json] = None,
    val choice : Choice,
    val empty : Empty,
    val entries : Seq[EntryElement],

    /**
     * An identifier.
     */
    val id : Long,

    val listMap : Map[String, Seq[String]],
    val lookup : Map[String, Map[String, Long]],
    val matrix : Seq[Seq[Double]],
    val maybeList : Option[Seq[Long]] = None,
    val maybeMap : Option[Map[String, String]] = None,

    /**
     * A name.
     * On two lines.
     */
    val name : String,

    val nothing : Option[Json] = None,
    val optionalEntry : Option[EntryElement] = None,
    val pick : PickUnion,
    val ratio : Double,
    val status : Status,
    val tags : Seq[String],
    val `this` : String,
    val toStringValue : String,
    val uuid : java.util.UUID,
    val when : java.time.Instant
)

object TopLevel:
    given io.circe.derivation.Configuration =
        io.circe.derivation.Configuration.default.withTransformMemberNames(
            io.circe.derivation.renaming.replaceWith(
                "weirdName" -> "?>weird\nname",
                "empty" -> "_",
                "topLevelAB" -> "a`b",
                "toStringValue" -> "toString"
            )
        )
    given io.circe.Codec.AsObject[TopLevel] = io.circe.derivation.ConfiguredCodec.derived

type Choice = Boolean | ChoiceEntry | Long | Seq[String] | String | NullValue
given Decoder[Choice] = {
    List[Decoder[Choice]](
        Decoder[String].widen,
        Decoder[Boolean].widen,
        Decoder[Long].widen,
        Decoder[Seq[String]].widen,
        Decoder[ChoiceEntry].widen,
        Decoder[NullValue].widen,
    ).reduceLeft(_ or _)
}

given Encoder[Choice] = Encoder.instance {
    case enc0 : String => Encoder.encodeString(enc0)
    case enc1 : Boolean => Encoder.encodeBoolean(enc1)
    case enc2 : Long => Encoder.encodeLong(enc2)
    case enc3 : Seq[String] => Encoder.encodeSeq[String].apply(enc3)
    case enc4 : ChoiceEntry => Encoder.AsObject[ChoiceEntry].apply(enc4)
    case enc5 : NullValue => Encoder.encodeNone(enc5)
}

/**
 * An entry.
 */
case class ChoiceEntry (
    val next : Option[Next] = None,

    /**
     * The value.
     */
    val value : Option[Double] = None
) derives Encoder.AsObject, Decoder

type Next = Double | EntryElement
given Decoder[Next] = {
    List[Decoder[Next]](
        Decoder[Double].widen,
        Decoder[EntryElement].widen,
    ).reduceLeft(_ or _)
}

given Encoder[Next] = Encoder.instance {
    case enc0 : Double => Encoder.encodeDouble(enc0)
    case enc1 : EntryElement => Encoder.AsObject[EntryElement].apply(enc1)
}

/**
 * An entry.
 */
case class EntryElement (
    val next : Option[EntryElement] = None,

    /**
     * The value.
     */
    val value : Double
) derives Encoder.AsObject, Decoder

type PickUnion = java.time.Instant | Double | PickEnum
given Decoder[PickUnion] = {
    List[Decoder[PickUnion]](
        Decoder[PickEnum].widen,
        Decoder[Double].widen,
        Decoder[java.time.Instant].widen,
    ).reduceLeft(_ or _)
}

given Encoder[PickUnion] = Encoder.instance {
    case enc0 : PickEnum => summon[Encoder[PickEnum]].apply(enc0)
    case enc1 : Double => Encoder.encodeDouble(enc1)
    case enc2 : java.time.Instant => summon[Encoder[java.time.Instant]].apply(enc2)
}

enum PickEnum : 
    case X
    case Y

given Decoder[PickEnum] = Decoder.decodeString.emap {
    case "x" => scala.Right(PickEnum.X)
    case "y" => scala.Right(PickEnum.Y)
    case other => scala.Left("invalid PickEnum: " + other)
}
given Encoder[PickEnum] = Encoder.encodeString.contramap {
    case PickEnum.X => "x"
    case PickEnum.Y => "y"
}

enum Status : 
    case Open
    case ItS
    case AB
    case LineBreak
    case Ünï
    case Type
    case Empty
    case Status

given Decoder[Status] = Decoder.decodeString.emap {
    case "open" => scala.Right(Status.Open)
    case "it's" => scala.Right(Status.ItS)
    case "a\\b" => scala.Right(Status.AB)
    case "line\nbreak" => scala.Right(Status.LineBreak)
    case "Ünï" => scala.Right(Status.Ünï)
    case "type" => scala.Right(Status.Type)
    case "_" => scala.Right(Status.Empty)
    case "" => scala.Right(Status.Status)
    case other => scala.Left("invalid Status: " + other)
}
given Encoder[Status] = Encoder.encodeString.contramap {
    case Status.Open => "open"
    case Status.ItS => "it's"
    case Status.AB => "a\\b"
    case Status.LineBreak => "line\nbreak"
    case Status.Ünï => "Ünï"
    case Status.Type => "type"
    case Status.Empty => "_"
    case Status.Status => ""
}

case class Empty()  derives Encoder.AsObject, Decoder

case class Item (
    val label : String
) derives Encoder.AsObject, Decoder

type Either = Long | String
given Decoder[Either] = {
    List[Decoder[Either]](
        Decoder[String].widen,
        Decoder[Long].widen,
    ).reduceLeft(_ or _)
}

given Encoder[Either] = Encoder.instance {
    case enc0 : String => Encoder.encodeString(enc0)
    case enc1 : Long => Encoder.encodeLong(enc1)
}

package quicktype

// Custom pickler so that missing keys and JSON nulls both read as None,
// and None is left out when writing (upickle's default for Option is a
// JSON array).
object OptionPickler extends upickle.AttributeTagged:
    import upickle.default.Writer
    import upickle.default.Reader
    override implicit def OptionWriter[T: Writer]: Writer[Option[T]] =
        implicitly[Writer[T]].comap[Option[T]] {
            case None => null.asInstanceOf[T]
            case Some(x) => x
        }

    override implicit def OptionReader[T: Reader]: Reader[Option[T]] = {
        new Reader.Delegate[Any, Option[T]](implicitly[Reader[T]].map(Some(_))){
        override def visitNull(index: Int) = None
        }
    }
end OptionPickler

// If a union has a null in, then we'll need this too...
type NullValue = None.type
given OptionPickler.ReadWriter[NullValue] = OptionPickler.readwriter[ujson.Value].bimap[NullValue](
    _ => ujson.Null,
    json => if json.isNull then None else throw new upickle.core.Abort("not null")
)
given OptionPickler.ReadWriter[java.time.Instant] = OptionPickler.readwriter[ujson.Value].bimap(
    value => ujson.Str(value.toString),
    json => json match
        case ujson.Str(value) => java.time.Instant.parse(value)
        case other => throw new upickle.core.Abort("expected date-time, got " + other)
)
given OptionPickler.ReadWriter[java.util.UUID] = OptionPickler.readwriter[String].bimap(
    _.toString,
    value =>
        val uuid = java.util.UUID.fromString(value)
        if uuid.toString.equalsIgnoreCase(value) then uuid else throw new upickle.core.Abort("invalid UUID")
)

object JsonExt:
    val valueReader = OptionPickler.readwriter[ujson.Value]

    // upickle's built-in primitive readers are lenient -- the numeric and
    // boolean readers accept strings, and the string reader accepts
    // numbers and booleans -- so untagged unions need strict readers to
    // pick the right member.
    val strictString: OptionPickler.Reader[String] = valueReader.map {
        case ujson.Str(s) => s
        case json => throw new upickle.core.Abort("expected string, got " + json)
    }
    val strictLong: OptionPickler.Reader[Long] = valueReader.map {
        case ujson.Num(n) if n.isWhole => n.toLong
        case json => throw new upickle.core.Abort("expected integer, got " + json)
    }
    val strictDouble: OptionPickler.Reader[Double] = valueReader.map {
        case ujson.Num(n) => n
        case json => throw new upickle.core.Abort("expected number, got " + json)
    }
    val strictBoolean: OptionPickler.Reader[Boolean] = valueReader.map {
        case ujson.Bool(b) => b
        case json => throw new upickle.core.Abort("expected boolean, got " + json)
    }

    def badMerge[T](r1: => OptionPickler.Reader[?], rest: OptionPickler.Reader[?]*): OptionPickler.Reader[T] = valueReader.map { json =>
        var t: T | Null = null
        val stack       = Vector.newBuilder[Throwable]
        (r1 +: rest).foreach { reader =>
            if t == null then
            try
                t = OptionPickler.read[T](json, trace = true)(using reader.asInstanceOf[OptionPickler.Reader[T]])
            catch
                case exc => stack += exc
        }
        if t != null then t.nn else throw new Exception(json.toString(), stack.result().headOption.getOrElse(null))
    }
end JsonExt
given OptionPickler.Reader[Long] = JsonExt.strictLong

     */

    val matrix : Seq[Seq[Double]],

type Choice = Boolean | ChoiceEntry | Long | Seq[String] | String | NullValue
given unionReaderChoice: OptionPickler.Reader[Choice] = JsonExt.badMerge[Choice](
    JsonExt.strictString,
    JsonExt.strictBoolean,
    JsonExt.strictLong,
    summon[OptionPickler.Reader[Seq[String]]],
    summon[OptionPickler.Reader[ChoiceEntry]],
    summon[OptionPickler.Reader[NullValue]],
    )

given unionWriterChoice: OptionPickler.Writer[Choice] = OptionPickler.writer[ujson.Value].comap[Choice]{ _v =>
    (_v: @unchecked) match 
        case v: String => OptionPickler.writeJs[String](v)
        case v: Boolean => OptionPickler.writeJs[Boolean](v)
        case v: Long => OptionPickler.writeJs[Long](v)
        case v: Seq[String] => OptionPickler.writeJs[Seq[String]](v)
        case v: ChoiceEntry => OptionPickler.writeJs[ChoiceEntry](v)
        case v: NullValue => OptionPickler.writeJs[NullValue](v)
}

    val next : Option[Next] = None,

    /**
     * The value.
     */
    val value : Option[Double] = None
) derives OptionPickler.ReadWriter

type Next = Double | EntryElement
given unionReaderNext: OptionPickler.Reader[Next] = JsonExt.badMerge[Next](
    JsonExt.strictDouble,
    summon[OptionPickler.Reader[EntryElement]],
    )

given unionWriterNext: OptionPickler.Writer[Next] = OptionPickler.writer[ujson.Value].comap[Next]{ _v =>
    (_v: @unchecked) match 
        case v: Double => OptionPickler.writeJs[Double](v)
        case v: EntryElement => OptionPickler.writeJs[EntryElement](v)
}

/**
 * An entry.
 */
case class EntryElement (
    val next : Option[EntryElement] = None,

    /**
     * The value.
     */
    val value : Double
) derives OptionPickler.ReadWriter

type PickUnion = java.time.Instant | Double | PickEnum
given unionReaderPickUnion: OptionPickler.Reader[PickUnion] = JsonExt.badMerge[PickUnion](
    summon[OptionPickler.Reader[PickEnum]],
    JsonExt.strictDouble,
    summon[OptionPickler.Reader[java.time.Instant]],
    )

given unionWriterPickUnion: OptionPickler.Writer[PickUnion] = OptionPickler.writer[ujson.Value].comap[PickUnion]{ _v =>
    (_v: @unchecked) match 
        case v: PickEnum => OptionPickler.writeJs[PickEnum](v)
        case v: Double => OptionPickler.writeJs[Double](v)
        case v: java.time.Instant => OptionPickler.writeJs[java.time.Instant](v)
}

enum PickEnum : 
    case X
    case Y

given OptionPickler.ReadWriter[PickEnum] = OptionPickler.readwriter[String].bimap[PickEnum](
    {
        case PickEnum.X => "x"
        case PickEnum.Y => "y"
    },
    {
        case "x" => PickEnum.X
        case "y" => PickEnum.Y
        case other => throw new upickle.core.Abort("invalid PickEnum: " + other)
    }
)

enum Status : 
    case Open
    case ItS
    case AB
    case LineBreak
    case Ünï
    case Type
    case Empty
    case Status

given OptionPickler.ReadWriter[Status] = OptionPickler.readwriter[String].bimap[Status](
    {
        case Status.Open => "open"
        case Status.ItS => "it's"
        case Status.AB => "a\\b"
        case Status.LineBreak => "line\nbreak"
        case Status.Ünï => "Ünï"
        case Status.Type => "type"
        case Status.Empty => "_"
        case Status.Status => ""
    },
    {
        case "open" => Status.Open
        case "it's" => Status.ItS
        case "a\\b" => Status.AB
        case "line\nbreak" => Status.LineBreak
        case "Ünï" => Status.Ünï
        case "type" => Status.Type
        case "_" => Status.Empty
        case "" => Status.Status
        case other => throw new upickle.core.Abort("invalid Status: " + other)
    }
)

case class Empty()
 derives OptionPickler.ReadWriter
case class Item (
    val label : String
) derives OptionPickler.ReadWriter

type Either = Long | String
given unionReaderEither: OptionPickler.Reader[Either] = JsonExt.badMerge[Either](
    JsonExt.strictString,
    JsonExt.strictLong,
    )

given unionWriterEither: OptionPickler.Writer[Either] = OptionPickler.writer[ujson.Value].comap[Either]{ _v =>
    (_v: @unchecked) match 
        case v: String => OptionPickler.writeJs[String](v)
        case v: Long => OptionPickler.writeJs[Long](v)
